description.value: The Davison Farmhouse Café occupies the original 1946 farmhouse on a working fifth-generation orchard property in Vernon's Okanagan Valley, offering farm-to-table breakfasts and lunches where many ingredients are grown steps away. The café is known for house-made pies, freshly crafted lattes, and seasonal baked goods, with indoor seating and patios overlooking the orchards. It is part of Davison Orchards, a family farm operating since 1933 that also runs U-pick experiences and guided orchard tours — a genuinely distinctive stop in the Okanagan.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at davisonorchards.ca/farmhouse-cafe confirms this is the 'Farmhouse Cafe' (not 'Deep Dish Cafe' as in OSM), a farm-to-table cafe at Davison Orchards in Vernon, BC. Address (3111 Davison Road) and phone (250-549-3266) come entirely from the website since OSM tags carry none. The FAQ notes seasonal closure but states 'See you on May 1st, 2026' and the contact page confirms the season runs May 1–October 31; as today is May 29, 2026, the business is currently open. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, or most cycling amenities appears anywhere on the site; the FAQ does explicitly confirm gluten-free options.
concerns: OSM name 'Deep Dish Cafe' does not match the actual business name 'Farmhouse Cafe' (also styled 'Davison Farmhouse Café' on the website). The OSM record should be corrected.
